Initial-setup calibration displays

Source: Prusa Research, Prusa-Firmware-Buddy v8.0.0 and v6.5.7
https://github.com/prusa3d/Prusa-Firmware-Buddy

Door-sensor, loadcell and filament-sensor controller text/layout are adapted for a read-only browser phase guide. Native diagrams and icons are unmodified and retain CC BY-NC-SA4.0. Supplemental glyph atlases adapt original bitmap cells using their original coverage; Latin glyphs retain Liberation OFL and Katakana retain Migu/IPA terms. See ../README.txt, ../Liberation-OFL.txt and ../IPA-Font-License.txt. Firmware-derived code retains GPL-3.0-only, with the full upstream terms at ../../../licenses/Buddy-LICENSE.md.

Corresponding source, original notices, exact inputs and rebuild instructions:
source/vendor/prusa-firmware-buddy/initial-setup/README.md
scripts/firmware-initial-setup-spec.mjs
scripts/build-initial-setup-displays.mjs
scripts/build-initial-setup-glyphs.py

The guide retains official photos, identifies conditional examples and does not supply live temperature/position readings or certify calibration of a printer.
